exposed_dft_features.name: Mode Register Read (MRR)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: In-band read of device-info, operating-mode, refresh, and status mode registers — primary observability path.

exposed_dft_features.name: Read DQ Calibration (RDCAL) / Read FIFO
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Returns a deterministic calibration pattern / FIFO contents for read-path training without array access.

exposed_dft_features.name: Write FIFO
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Loads a known pattern through the write path for write-path training without disturbing the array.

exposed_dft_features.name: WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Exercises and validates the WCK-to-CK phase-lock / clock path before transfers.

exposed_dft_features.name: Link ECC status
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Read/Write Link ECC flags corrected single-bit errors on the wire — a soft-error observability hook.

exposed_dft_features.name: ZQ calibration
exposed_dft_features.purpose: On-die impedance calibration against the external reference resistor.

exposed_dft_features.name: Per-state IDD specifications
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Defined per-state current points enable power-state characterization.

fields.no_jtag_on_DRAM_balls: LPDDR5 SDRAM has no JTAG / boundary-scan / scan-shift pins at the package interface. Vendor scan / BIST runs at wafer-probe time and is not accessible in the field.
controller_side_dft_aids: Per-byte-lane PHY observability: LPDDR5 PHY IP exposes RX FIFO, WCK2CK leveling state, per-bit deskew, eye-margin sweeps, DFE tap settings, Vref training results via a vendor-specific control register interface.
Logic-analyzer / oscilloscope probing of CK / WCK / RDQS / CA[6:0] / CS / DQ / DMI on the package or interposer.
RDCAL fixed calibration pattern as a deterministic read self-test through the PHY.
Link-ECC error counters and system-level ECC (controller side) as soft-error / defect indicators.
fields.notes: LPDDR5 SDRAM (JESD209-5) does not specify a formal in-system scan / JTAG / boundary-scan architecture at the DRAM balls. Bus-level DFT is limited to MRR, RDCAL / Read-FIFO read training, Write-FIFO write training, WCK2CK synchronization, ZQ calibration, and Link-ECC status. Internal DRAM die scan, BIST, redundancy-row repair, and wafer-level burn-in are vendor-proprietary.
